title: Don't crash startup when litellm ships a new exception type
problem_type: litellm 新增异常类型触发 LiteLLMExceptions._load 无条件 raise（strict 参数从未使用）
approach: 落地 strict 参数：strict=True 保留漂移检查；默认路径警告放行；不注册未知错误进 catch 元组（dir(litellm) 含 pydantic ValidationError 等第三方 re-export）

policy.summary: CONTRIBUTING.md 无 AI 禁令（仅 LLM benchmark 章节）；无 DCO 要求；fork PR 通道正常

collision.summary: 五查：issue #5944 timeline 0 cross-ref、0 评论、无认领语言；邻近编号 #5943-#5946 无同题 PR；作者 mintyYuki 仅报告未自修

verification.summary: 修复前构造抛 ValueError（与 issue 回溯逐字一致），新回归测试未打补丁时 fail；修复后构造成功并按未映射名警告，tests/basic/test_exceptions.py 9 passed（7 存量+2 新增）；black 23.3.0/flake8 7.1.0/isort 5.12.0 全净

submission.head: e980beec7930f0e38cb0769eba362bbef094491d

claims.text: Pre-fix with litellm 1.108.0, constructing `LiteLLMExceptions()` reproduces exactly the issue's failure
Post-fix the same construction succeeds (warns once per unmapped name) and `tests/basic/test_exceptions.py` passes 9/9
`black 23.3.0 --line-length 100 --preview`, `flake8 7.1.0` and `isort 5.12.0` (the repo's pre-commit pins) are all clean on the two touched files.

limitations: A real LLM chat session was not exercised (it needs live API keys); the change only touches exception-map loading and warning paths, which the regression tests cover directly.
Per-name retry semantics for the 8 currently-unmapped litellm errors are maintainer classification calls and are intentionally untouched here.
